method: Six complete pinned files read. Original IO functions AST-extracted and run with minimal config/loader/Dataset substitutes and temporary local directory; injected read/write OSError, no actual HuggingFace execution.
findings: load_dataset disables global progress bars before loader and re-enables only on success, not finally. Original-function control confirms loader OSError leaves progress disabled. Existing caller progress state is not restored explicitly.

save_dataset writes clusters.pickle before saving dataset and mutates keep_index_column to true. Injected dataset-save OSError leaves clusters.pickle present without successful dataset output; no atomic multi-artifact publication is implemented here.

Loader assigns row-position internal index through map, overwriting same-named existing column; configured index_column is not used by reviewed loader. No schema collision validation shown in these files.

save_dataset removes internal index/cluster columns according to flags, but does not remove __duplicate__ or Bloom duplicate flags. Extra markers can survive output unless other path removes them. Source-only observation.

Config settings sources return TOML source only; helper temporarily changes class-global model_config then restores in finally. Concurrent loads could share mutable configuration; no concurrency runtime test.

Bloom path processes one worker to preserve state, marks positive membership as duplicate and filters it without exact content confirmation. error_rate is explicitly configurable, so positive Bloom membership is not exact equality proof. No actual Bloom false-positive experiment executed.
Bloom map uses fresh UUID fingerprint to avoid reusing cached stateful map. Clearing dataset cache occurs only after successful save in main; no finally cleanup for failed processing shown.

result.scope: Original IO functions with fake config/Dataset/loader and temporary local directory; no HuggingFace runtime execution.

limits: No full upstream tests, actual datasets/rbloom/Pydantic runtime or production changes. pHash/ASAN deferred.
